scope: Independent source pose notes for drafting; appearance approval and native motion remain pending.
global_constraints: This is a round bulb-headed octopus, not the earlier long-mantled FIRE2 squid. Prior squid art may guide red material only.
Original palette is diagnostic. Preserve silhouette, visible eye count, overlap and attached water; do not infer real colors from diagnostic red/yellow.
Do not force eight separately exposed arms if the source hides or overlaps them.
Rear-quarter030–037 retain only the small far-right eye edge where visible;038–039 are eyeless rear views.
Fish counts here are visible source forms, not claims about an invariant carried count or executed phase order.
Existing static site associations are reused as reported.028 has no unique static action attribution in this source record; that does not establish it as unused.
